background.reason: Corner-connected dominant border color; score = border support × matching corner fraction

map.reason: Crop follows largest spatial component; score is its share of supported foreground, not proof of a map

ocr_results.reason: Context/glyph-checked words and coherent lines; rejected OCR candidates are preserved separately from confirmed text

spirals.reason: Visual spiral search disabled or insufficient image support

basemap_extraction.reason: Physical terrain, base fills and marginal annotations are excluded before colour grids are pooled.

measurement_layer.reason: Physical terrain, base fills and marginal annotations are excluded before colour grids are pooled.
measurement_layer.limitation: RGB appearance inference; overlays indistinguishable from terrain or hidden by it cannot be recovered exactly.

library.name: Active Fires Robinson 2020
library.explanation: Worldwide fire intensity and distribution. Warm clusters mark visible fire activity. Listen for where clusters occur and how strongly they stand out.

legend.text: 1–250 MW — fire radiative power; dark red → yellow → white = increasing power

library.note: Prepared with scanner cleanup, basemap removal and 256 x 128 sparse grids. Spiral detection omitted because the studio has no spiral mode.
